stories.h: Tacoma ICE detention center sold to feds for $453M
stories.s: GEO Group sold the 1,635-bed Northwest ICE Processing Center to the federal government and will keep running it under a 10-year contract. Reps. Randall and Jayapal criticized the price and promised oversight.

stories.h: Combined ER and urgent care coming to Puyallup
stories.s: Virginia Mason Franciscan Health plans 24-hour emergency and urgent care sites in Puyallup, Issaquah and Seattle's Lake City in 2027, with lab, X-ray and CT on site.

stories.h: Puyallup mother pleads guilty in son's fentanyl death
stories.s: A woman pleaded guilty to second-degree manslaughter in her 5-year-old son's 2025 fentanyl death. Both sides recommend 21 months; sentencing is expected in February.

stories.h: Uwajimaya's Tacoma store opening slips to 2028
stories.s: The Asian grocer now lists 2028 for its planned store at the former Hobby Lobby on S. 23rd Street, a year later than first announced, with city permit revisions pending.

coming.h: Holiday congestion expected on I-5 Lacey–Tacoma
coming.s: WSDOT names I-5 between Lacey and Tacoma a Thanksgiving hot spot and has posted best and worst travel times for Nov. 25–29.

coming.h: Zoolights opens at Point Defiance Zoo
coming.s: The light show runs 4:30–10 p.m. nightly through Jan. 3; timed online tickets required, from $16.
